purpose: Test whether a wick-only failure through a causally confirmed local swing followed by a completed close back inside the level can time immediate 30-second reversal entries better than prior continuation/oscillator families.

public_logic_sources.source: MetaQuotes Liquidity Sweep Detector Code Base 76586
public_logic_sources.logic: fractal swing point; later closed bar wick pierces swing and closes back on the other side
active swing high: high > level with close < level is a wick-only sweep; close beyond level is a true break
bearish wick above prior swing high and close below; bullish wick below prior swing low and close above
pivot sweep plus close rejection; optional stronger close-position filter

independence: No session range or previous-day level.
Entry is a local swing false-break rejection event.
swing_semantics: symmetric two-bar confirmed fractal swing, revealed only after two completed right-side bars; each swing identity consumed on its first wick/close interaction beyond the level

R037-SFP-C01_M1_BASIC.rule: bear high>swingHigh and close<swingHigh; bull low<swingLow and close>swingLow

R037-SFP-C02_M1_HALF_REJECTION.rule: basic SFP plus close in reversal half of sweep candle

R037-SFP-C04_M5_HALF_REJECTION.rule: basic SFP plus close in reversal half of sweep candle

ambiguity_rule: If one completed bar simultaneously forms valid bullish and bearish SFPs against both active swings, consume both touched swing identities and emit no proposal.
proposal_timing: first executable tick at/after completed SFP bar edge

screen_gate.winner_or_quality_gate: official-win delta nonnegative OR positive net with improved gross loss
